llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, file-based todo workflow that only reads and manipulates markdown files in a todos/ directory; its requirements and instructions are consistent with the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the content: the skill is explicitly about creating, triaging, listing, and managing markdown todos in a todos/ directory. It does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to filesystem operations and shell snippets that read, list, copy, rename, and search files in todos/ (grep, ls, cp, mv). These are in-scope for a file-based todo manager. Note: workflows mention a slash command (/ia-triage) and CLI integrations (gh CLI) but the skill does not declare those as required binaries—those integrations are optional and not invoked by any embedded network endpoints. The skill can rename and move files, so users should expect file modifications when following the instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer step beyond normal file edits a user or agent would perform in the todos/ directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. Template and docs reference generic links/placeholders but do not ask for secrets or unrelated credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true (the skill cannot be invoked autonomously by models), so it has no elevated persistence or autonomous execution privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only skill that manipulates markdown files in a local todos/ directory and is coherent with its description. It does not request credentials or install code. Before using: back up your todos/ directory (the workflows include cp/mv commands), be aware that integrations mentioned (slash commands, gh CLI) are optional and may require additional tooling if you want them, and only install/use this skill if you trust the source since instruction-only skills run commands in your workspace. No scanner findings were produced because the package contains only docs and templates.
